spans.s:
1. Vena occurs in one passage of the Rigveda^1 as a generous
patron. Pṛthavāna, found in the same passage, may or may
not be another name of his, and Pārthya in the following
stanza of the hymn is perhaps his patronymic.
1) x. 93, 14. Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 166.

2. Vena in the Rigveda^1 is thought by Tilak^2 to be the
planet Venus. But this is certainly impossible.
1) x. 123.
2) Oriea, 163 et seq
Cf. Whitney, Journal of the American
Oriental Society, 16, xciv.
